interactive_questions.title: Customer Support AI
interactive_questions.prompt: Understand how AI agents automate customer support.
interactive_questions.question: What is the primary role of a Customer Support Agent?
options: B. To autonomously resolve user issues and answer inquiries.
interactive_questions.answer: B. To autonomously resolve user issues and answer inquiries.
interactive_questions.explanation: Customer support agents automate interactions with users, resolving issues quickly.

theory.title: Customer Support Agents
theory.content: Customer support agents handle repetitive user inquiries by connecting to knowledge bases and ticketing systems.
theory.analogy: A tireless front-desk receptionist who knows every answer.

critical_concepts.elaboration: Agents capable of interacting with users via real-time spoken language.

interactive_questions.title: Voice Based Support
interactive_questions.prompt: Explore how voice AI handles support calls.
interactive_questions.question: Why are conversational voice agents effective in support?
options: A. They only work during business hours.
B. They provide instant, natural, and hands-free assistance to users.
C. They require users to type long descriptions.
D. They are slower than text chatbots.
interactive_questions.answer: B. They provide instant, natural, and hands-free assistance to users.
interactive_questions.explanation: Voice agents can converse naturally and resolve issues via speech, offering a high-quality user experience.

theory.title: Conversational Voice Based Agent
theory.content: These agents use speech-to-text, LLMs, and text-to-speech to hold fluid conversations with users over the phone or web.
theory.analogy: A hyper-efficient call center operator who never puts you on hold.
